decision.question: Does procurement add enough incremental evidence to replace or supplement the 1962-2002 yield-and-FX proxy experiment?
decision.answer: Supplement, not replace, and only conditionally. One combined read 1962-2002 (proxy rates and FX plus vendor commodities and non-US rates from their first trade) is the only design whose power at the programme level clears 0.5 at a single-market AR of 0.2, and only if trend-return correlations are near the 1985-2009 levels Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen report (uniform rho about 0.1 or less). At rho 0.2-0.3 the gain is small and neither design is an admission test. Replacing the proxy with vendor data alone (1975 or 1980 to 2002) is dominated by the combined read.
